description: This file defines a function to fetch and process a list of organizations (tenants) from an API endpoint. It includes logic to normalize various identifier and name fields, sort the resulting list, and handle errors.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches organizations data from the API endpoint '/session/tenants', normalizes the data fields, sorts the list by name and id, and returns an array of organization objects with id and name properties.
